expected.body: An 18-month-old exclusively breastfed boy presents with bowed legs and swelling of the wrists. X-ray shows metaphyseal cupping. Labs: ↓ 25-(OH)D₃, ↑ PTH, ↓ phosphate, ↑ ALP. Diagnosis: Nutritional rickets. Key teaching: breast milk is low in vitamin D; supplement with oral vitamin D beginning in the first few days of life.
